text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hm… I think maybe I focused a bit too much on the fighting…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well, I tried a trick my papa taught me to help me fall asleep…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: When I can't sleep, I imagine every wrestler challenging me one by one!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: He told me that imagination would eventually turn into a dream. But…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This one wrestler jumped in unannounced… I almost had them, but… Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like El Condor Pasa didn't get enough sleep.
